SSS91.name: 纪元龙鱼
SSS91.form: a serpentine body, a row of evenly spaced dorsal spines, a crest of thin blades along the nape, a pair of short barbels under the jaw, resinous scales
SSS91.fins: a continuous low dorsal crest, a pair of narrow pectoral fins, a long tapering tail fin
SSS91.markings: a row of luminous nodes along the spine, a single seam line down the flank
SSS91.colour: 暗青底、纪元琥珀脊，鳞缘冷金

SSS92.name: 时之终点·无相鲲
SSS92.form: a vast rounded body, a smooth featureless head, eyes reduced to faint marks, deep parallel throat pleats, a silhouette deliberately kept simple
SSS92.fins: long slim pectoral flippers, a small set-back dorsal fin, a broad horizontal fluke
SSS92.markings: a single faint seam line running along the flank
SSS92.colour: 无相灰白底、极简，边缘虚空淡青

SSS93.name: 初源之影·混沌
SSS93.form: a serpentine body carrying an uneven assembly of features, a ridge of irregular dorsal spines, twin coiled horns, mismatched scale plating along the back
SSS93.fins: a ragged dorsal crest of uneven rays, a pair of asymmetric pectoral fins
SSS93.markings: scattered faceted plates along the back
SSS93.colour: 混沌青褐底、拼接质感，杂色棱面

SSS94.name: 终焉纪元·忘川
SSS94.form: a long lean streamlined body, a narrow tapered snout, underslung jaws set with rows of even teeth, five long gill slits, smooth matte hide
SSS94.fins: a tall dorsal fin, long swept pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin with a long upper lobe
SSS94.markings: a single band crossing the mid-body, a row of luminous pores along the flank
SSS94.colour: 忘川灰蓝底、冷潮线，牙列象牙白

SSS95.name: 时之尽头·无相巨鲲
SSS95.form: a vast rounded body, a smooth featureless head, eyes reduced to faint marks, deep parallel throat pleats, a compact set-back dorsal fin
SSS95.fins: slim pectoral flippers, a small set-back dorsal fin, a broad notched horizontal fluke
SSS95.markings: concentric seam lines across the head
SSS95.colour: 尽头灰底、层叠冷纹，边缘虚空青

SSS96.name: 创世之鳞
SSS96.form: a serpentine body armored in large overlapping faceted scales, a row of evenly spaced dorsal spines, a pair of short forward-swept horns
SSS96.fins: a continuous low dorsal crest, a pair of narrow pectoral fins, a long tapering tail fin
SSS96.markings: overlapping scale rows across the flank, a single row of luminous nodes along the spine
SSS96.colour: 创世青金底、层鳞棱面，脊线冷光

SSS97.name: 终末渔者之影
SSS97.form: a slender elongated body, a blunt upright head, a small terminal mouth, a row of thin whisker-like barbels under the jaw, long trailing dorsal and pelvic filaments
SSS97.fins: a long trailing dorsal filament, narrow pectoral fins, a forked tail fin
SSS97.markings: a tattered fringe along the lower flank
SSS97.colour: 影灰底、渔者冷线，边缘褪色

SSS98.name: 纪元终焉·空之鲸
SSS98.form: a vast smooth body tapering to a narrow tail stock, a heavy rounded head, deep throat pleats, long slim pectoral flippers
SSS98.fins: long slim pectoral flippers, a small set-back dorsal fin, a wide notched horizontal fluke
SSS98.markings: a row of pores along the jaw line, faint seam lines across the head
SSS98.colour: 空灰蓝底、纪元冷白腹，深渊青光

SSS99.name: 最初之鳞·混沌
SSS99.form: a coiled serpentine body, a ragged dorsal ridge of uneven plates, a pair of backward-swept horns, rows of exposed fangs along both jaws
SSS99.fins: a continuous low dorsal crest, a pair of narrow pectoral fins
SSS99.markings: uneven plate rows across the back, a row of luminous nodes along the spine
SSS99.colour: 初源灰白底、混沌杂纹，牙棘冷白

SSS100.name: 终焉之影·忘川
SSS100.form: a massive deep-bodied form, a broad head with a short tapered snout, wide jaws, five long gill slits, a low keel along the flank
SSS100.fins: a tall dorsal fin, long swept pectoral fins, a strongly curved tail fin with a long upper lobe
SSS100.markings: a faint vertical band behind the gill slits
SSS100.colour: 终末墨蓝底、微光鳞面，尾缘冷白
